name: con
text: We had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend this accommodation. It offers the perfect balance of being in a peaceful, secluded location while still being just a short drive from town. The house was exceptionally clean, with large, spacious rooms and stunning views of the ocean. Having access to a private beach was a real highlight—it was perfect for swimming when the sea was calm. The outdoor area was absolutely beautiful and felt like having our own private resort. The host was incredibly kind and generous. They welcomed us with a fridge fully stocked with food and drinks and even brought us delicious homemade Greek food during our stay, which was such a thoughtful and memorable touch. The house was fully equipped with everything we needed, and travelling with our one-year-old baby was made so much easier because the accommodation had everything we could have asked for. Overall, it was a relaxing and memorable stay, and we would gladly return in the future.

name: SégolèneC
text: Dear visitors to eastern Crete, look no further—you have just found the best place! We came to this magnificent location for our honeymoon and, clearly, it exceeded our expectations. First of all, the view is absolutely splendid and allows you to watch the changing light over the sea in complete tranquillity. A lovely little pebble beach is just a few steps away, and you will find it very peaceful. The house has everything you need for a perfect stay. And what can we say about our hosts? Their welcome reflected the warmth of Crete. We felt welcomed like family, and they took great care of us with many lovely gestures while still giving us all the privacy we had come to find away from everything. A thousand thanks to you—these memories will stay with us forever.

name: Jenny
text: We spent a week at Platani Seaside Villa as a family of five. The house is an absolute recommendation! It is the most beautiful holiday villa we have ever stayed in! The house and its dreamlike location exceeded all our expectations. Communication with the owners and the welcome were exceptionally warm and friendly! We were greeted with a wonderful welcome package full of delicacies and fantastic homemade food. The house is equipped with absolutely everything you could possibly imagine. It is beautifully and comfortably furnished, and we felt right at home. The villa's outdoor area is sensationally beautiful, with a large, very well-equipped outdoor kitchen featuring a BBQ grill and seating area, which we used every day. There is also a great table tennis table, which our teenagers loved, and an outdoor shower. The sea is only a few steps away, and you practically have the beach all to yourself! The location is perfect for excursions, and the nearest town, Sitia, with all its supermarkets and tavernas, is only a ten-minute drive away. We can hardly wait to return!

name: Jerzy
text: A unique place, a unique location. Very kind and helpful hosts. We had a wonderful time with friends over the past few days. Beautiful sunrises. Peace and quiet.

name: Katherine
text: The Platani Seaside Villa is an exceptional property very, very close to the pebble and sand beach of Platani. The hosts were wonderfully kind and hospitable, providing us with a delicious home-cooked moussaka to enjoy when we arrived in the evening, alongside bottles of water, a bottle of wine and raki! There is a balcony with a table and chairs, and a hanging chair where you can look out to the sea and the white cliffs. The view is stunning! The two bedrooms we used look out over the sea and the lovely garden terrace, complete with table tennis, water fountains and an impressive grill area. There is also a shower for when you come in from the sea. Everything has been thought of to make your visit comfortable and enjoyable. Nearby there is a beautiful gorge walk, and you can also hike up the road to a monastery with amazing views. As you walk down to the sea from the villa (50 yards), you pass another small vacation property, but the owners of this place were quiet and unobtrusive. We enjoyed our time at Platani so much, and we hope to return one day! Thank you so much for the wonderful time!

name: Anja
text: The house feels like a real villa, not just a holiday home. The waterfall system was great for our five-year-old to play with. The beach is public, but no one except us ever went there. The location is super secluded and the mountains offer some wind protection. There is a lot of fine equipment in the house, such as a Nespresso machine, many games and a small air hockey table. The landlords were super friendly and helpful and exceeded our expectations by far. We believe this is exactly what most people are looking for.

name: Una
text: This villa is a gem. The surroundings are so beautiful you have to pinch yourself to make sure you're not dreaming when you walk out onto the balcony in the morning with a coffee. The secluded pebble beach is right on the doorstep, but unlike the wild beaches you might find elsewhere in Crete, this one comes with a well-appointed outside patio and garden area, which includes an outdoor shower, sun loungers and everything else you might desire. Inside, the house is spacious and clean. There are mosquito nets on all the windows and balcony doors, so you can keep the windows open in the evening and at night—we were there in the autumn and did not feel the need to use air conditioning. You fall asleep listening to the sea. It feels like the hosts have thought of everything. There is a more than sufficient quantity of anything you might need, from breakfast supplies and drinking water kept cool in the fridge to olive oil, wine, coffee pods and washing capsules. The hosts are a family, truly hospitable, warm and generous, and they made the experience something more than just another vacation. We hope to return.

name: Vincent
text: We received an exceptional welcome and will always cherish wonderful memories of our vacation thanks to our extraordinary hosts! The culture of hospitality has been deeply rooted in their family for several generations, as this place was once a taverna run by their grandparents. They have now renovated the house with great charm and comfort, and the exceptional view and proximity to the sea make it a little paradise. Our hosts made sure that we never lacked anything. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you and congratulations on such a wonderful welcome! We hope that one day we will be able to welcome Stravos and Poppi to our region with the same care and professionalism!

name: Reinkober
text: We received a very warm welcome from Emmanouel. The accommodation is exactly as described, with a beautiful view of the sea, and it is located in a very quiet area. It is furnished with great care and warmth. Everything has been thought of and everything you could need is available. We were welcomed with a delicious treat from the parents, and during our stay we were also spoiled with Greek specialties. A small breakfast was provided for the following day as well. Emmanouel gave us several tips and ideas for things to do in the surrounding area, and Sitia, the nearest town, can also be reached quickly. We thoroughly enjoyed our time in Crete and can only recommend this accommodation. We will definitely return.

name: Lenka
text: An incredible place, a fantastic house with many thoughtful details and an amazing welcome. The hosts are a wonderful family who made us feel like part of their family from the very first moment. The people and the surroundings captivate you and make you feel at home. We were sad when the time came to say goodbye. It is a unique corner of Crete that we will return to next year. The beach has pebbles and crystal-clear turquoise water, making it an ideal place for snorkelling and relaxing as a family. Thank you, Popi, for your meals and cooking, which introduced us to the authentic food of the area. Five stars—you are a wonderful cook, and thank you so much. The house has everything you could possibly need or expect, and even more. When we arrived, we were very happy that we had chosen this place for our long-awaited vacation. A one-kilometre walk away is a village with a very important Orthodox church. The village is lively, and you can eat at an authentic taverna serving local dishes. A perfect 10. Thank you so much. We love you.

name: Arianna
text: The villa is wonderful and set in a unique location. It is perfect for anyone who wants to spend a vacation in complete tranquillity, surrounded by truly fantastic and unique natural beauty. The owners are extremely kind and always available. We found everything we needed to prepare our meals and breakfasts. The bedrooms and bathrooms were spotlessly clean and equipped with every essential. There are several relaxation areas with very comfortable sun loungers and chairs placed throughout the property. The practically private beach has unforgettable seabeds. We spent some truly wonderful days here. I wholeheartedly recommend this property and wish Poppy and her family every success in their business and in life.

name: Nicolas
text: Our little paradise in Crete. We had the most amazing time! The place wasn't just beautifully decorated—it was right on the sea. You could literally roll out of bed and into the waves. Morning coffee with the sound of the ocean, sunrises right at our doorstep... it doesn't get more relaxing than this. We came back completely recharged and are already dreaming about our next visit.

name: Nicolas
text: Everything about this accommodation is perfect, from the incredible waterfront location to the warm welcome from the owners, who surprised us with many thoughtful gestures throughout our stay. The beach directly in front of the property has exceptionally clear water. The house itself is very comfortable and extremely well equipped. The very large terrace is also worth mentioning, beautifully illuminated and featuring small waterfalls and fountains. We are already looking forward to returning.

name: Soren
text: Fantastic location close to the beach with crystal-clear water. Lovely house and a wonderful welcome with homemade food.

name: Myriam
text: Simply wow! Our stay was exceptional from beginning to end. This truly is a little corner of paradise, directly beside the beach, with magnificent turquoise water. The courtyard is enormous, with a breathtaking view of the sea, an outdoor kitchen and everything you need to fully enjoy your stay. The house is tastefully decorated, comfortable and very clean. Communication with Emmanuel and his family was excellent, and what can we say about the warm welcome we received? There were so many thoughtful gestures, homemade dishes, as well as fresh vegetables and fruit from the garden. They are simply wonderful, warm and welcoming hosts. You made our stay unforgettable. We are already looking forward to returning for our next vacation. Thank you for everything!
